content:
According to recent backend code changes related to supporting the "car key" feature for the Tank brand under Great Wall Motors, Apple appears to be preparing to expand this feature to another brand under the same automaker. Here are the details.

It is reported that the "car key" feature in Apple Wallet will soon support Haval vehicles.

A few weeks ago, Apple added related code to its backend, showing that vehicles under Great Wall Motors' Tank brand would soon support the "car key" feature in Apple Wallet, allowing users to lock, unlock, and start compatible car models via iPhone or Apple Watch.

Now, as discovered by Aaron Perris on the X platform, similar code references have also appeared for another brand under the Chinese automaker — Haval:

Although several models under Great Wall Motors' Haval brand already offer CarPlay, none currently support Apple's standalone "car key" feature.

Once the new feature launches, compatible Haval models will join the ranks of more than 50 car models that currently support the "car key" feature, including vehicles from brands such as BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Kia, Genesis, Toyota, and Rivian.
